name: validate_checkout_slot
description: Validates the checkout slot step for a specific basket service type (e.g. 'driveclcv' for drive click-and-collect) on Carrefour France. Submits a device fingerprint ID and returns the current cart state, checkout step, store context, workflow steps, warnings, and available checkout links (payment, on-site payment, device fingerprint generator). Useful for confirming the slot selection step before proceeding to the payment step.

basket_service_type.description: The basket service type for checkout (e.g. 'driveclcv' for drive click-and-collect, 'lad' for home delivery, etc.)

deviceFingerPrintId.description: The device fingerprint ID generated by the fingerprint generator service, used for fraud prevention during checkout.
